name: Iryna
description: Old Money undead occultist and bonne vivante. Black sheep of a well-established vampyr clan. Ancestral home (and family) torn apart by nazis. Providing a significant portion of F.A.N.G. funding.
hooks: Poshest of all the characters, probably the best dressed
Abilities and equipment allow for interesting descriptions of magic
Players who want to be beautiful and elegant rulers of the night

abilities.name: Dark Glamour
abilities.description: Spend 1 Blood: those nearby are mesmerised by your unearthly visage.

abilities.name: Night's Willing Servants
abilities.description: Spend 1 Blood: summon a swarm of bats under your control.

abilities.name: Deadeye Shot
abilities.description: When you use a ranged weapon, SPECIAL: Reduce a Threat's Attack rating by 1.
abilities.special: Reduce a Threat's Attack rating by 1

advances.name: Hell's Ravenous Fire
advances.description: Spend 1 Blood: ignore Challenge on your next action against a Threat.

advances.name: Enervation of the Soul
advances.description: Spend 1 Blood: on your next roll, gain SPECIAL: Inflict 4 damage to an Übermensch.

advances.name: Mantle of the Fell Beast
advances.description: Spend 2 Blood: BRAWL and TERRIFY become 4, all other stats are set to 1, and you cannot use items. Lasts until the Objective is completed.

equipment.name: Cigarettes taken from the pockets of hanged men

5-6.major_penalty: May only use 1 item per turn

name: Nicole
description: Resistance guerrilla fighter and demolitions expert. Packing more heat than a whole platoon. Lost your cell to nazi purges, bitter about it. Bitten by your (now dead) vampire girlfriend. Desperate to meet a glorious end in battle.
hooks: For players who like guns, glorious self-destruction, or linear application of extreme violence
Has the most equipment items (6 weapons)

abilities.name: Scavenger
abilities.description: SPECIAL: Roll a D6 and compare it to the numbers in square brackets on Nicole's equipment list. Restore 1 use of the weapon rolled.
abilities.special: Roll D6, restore 1 use of weapon [1]-[6]

abilities.name: Sapper
abilities.description: When you use explosives, SPECIAL: reduce an Objective or Threat's Challenge by 1.
abilities.special: Reduce an Objective or Threat's Challenge by 1

abilities.name: Blink
abilities.description: Spend 1 Blood: burst into shadows and reform a few feet away.

advances.name: Rat Swarm
advances.description: Spend 1 Blood: summon a swarm of rats under your control.

advances.name: Feed on Fear
advances.description: When you reduce a Threat rating to 0, gain 3 Blood.

advances.name: Pitch Black
advances.description: Spend 1 Blood: plunge the area around you into shadow; you can see fine.

3-4.major_penalty: Spend 1 Blood at the start of your turn

5-6.major_penalty: May only use 1 item per turn

name: Cosgrave
description: Hackney necromancer, taught by your aunt. Medically dead, but can still walk around and that. On the run from East London's undead mafia. Crooked as a three bob note, but charming with it. Lots of weird black magic tricks.
hooks: Abilities come with expectation that players will use them in creative ways
Give to a player comfortable with improvising in the moment

abilities.name: Danse Macabre
abilities.description: Spend 1 Blood: gain full control of a corpse for around a minute, after which it falls apart.

abilities.name: Back-Pocket Hex
abilities.description: SPECIAL: Reduce a Threat's Attack rating by 1.
abilities.special: Reduce a Threat's Attack rating by 1

abilities.name: Phantasmagoria
abilities.description: Spend 1 Blood: conjure nightmare illusions in the area immediately around you.
abilities.bonus_condition: +incorporates the background in a clever way

advances.name: Memory Rot
advances.description: Spend 1 Blood: remove or implant memories from someone you lock eyes with.

advances.name: Death Burst
advances.description: Spend 1 Blood: curse a nazi within arm's reach to explode when they die.

advances.name: Dead Man's Luck
advances.description: After you roll your dice pool, before you discard dice, reduce the GM's successful Attack dice by 1 for each 1 you rolled.

5-6.major_penalty: Can't spend Blood to use abilities

name: Chuck
description: Grew up on the wrong side of the tracks, buried a sibling or two. Loves cowboy movies, honest work, human liver and the wide open plains. Genuinely decent guy, apart from the eating people bit. F.A.N.G. pulled you out of jail after you ate a county sheriff and half his deputy.
hooks: Incongruous and has plenty of opportunities to make light of situations
Give to the joker in your group

abilities.name: Acid Spit
abilities.description: Spend 1 Blood: hawk up a gutful of fierce acid.

abilities.name: Spider Scurry
abilities.description: Spend 1 Blood: skitter across ceilings and up walls.

abilities.name: Corpse Eater
abilities.description: After you roll your dice pool, before you discard dice, gain 1 Blood if you rolled any 1s.

advances.name: Elbow Grease
advances.description: When you roll up your sleeves and take on an Objective single-handed with the FIX stat, gain SPECIAL: reduce the Objective's rating by 4.

advances.name: Corrosive Fluids
advances.description: When you mark an Injury, reduce the rating of a Threat you're engaged with by 2.

advances.name: Lashing Tongue
advances.description: Spend 1 Blood: your strong, prehensile tongue extends several yards out of your mouth.

equipment.name: Cowboy hat
equipment.special_use: Mark to ignore an Injury or being Downed; hat is destroyed

1-2.major_penalty: Spend 1 Blood at the start of your turn

name: Astrid
description: Ex-fighter pilot, bitten by something after a crash in the frozen taiga. The parasite soul of a wild predator is nestled around your heart. Now ancient magic flows in your blood and wild spirits bow to you.
hooks: Most basic character in mechanical terms
For players who don't want complex decisions and just want to rip nazis in half

abilities.name: Apex Predator
abilities.description: SPECIAL: Reduce a Threat's rating by 3.

abilities.name: Unnatural Endurance
abilities.description: SPECIAL: Reduce the GM's Attack dice by 3.
abilities.special: Reduce the GM's Attack dice by 3

abilities.name: Bloodhunt
abilities.description: Spend 1 Blood: track targets or search for things using your sense of smell.

advances.name: Spirit Storm
advances.description: Spend 1 Blood: hurl items like a poltergeist.

advances.name: Tethered Phantom
advances.description: Spend 1 Blood: reduce an Objective or Threat's Challenge by 1 until the end of the round.

name: Flint
description: Born in a cave, driven out by nazis. Half-bat, half-human, all nightmare. Monstrous hunter with a taste for blood. May or may not be able to talk (possibly just shy).
hooks: Half-man half-bat monster who may or may not be able to talk
Good for players new to roleplaying or talking in-character
Big friendly dog-like creature that isn't very friendly to nazis

abilities.name: Ravenous
abilities.description: When you're in melee combat, SPECIAL: gain 3 Blood.

abilities.name: Sense Heartbeat
abilities.description: Spend 1 Blood: you can see the heartbeats of living beings through walls and other obstacles.

abilities.name: Improvised Projectile
abilities.description: Spend 1 Blood: chuck something large and heavy a surprising distance.

advances.name: Hellish Screech
advances.description: Spend 2 Blood: reduce a Threat's Challenge by 1.

advances.name: Bone Armour
advances.description: After you roll your dice pool, before you discard dice, reduce the GM's successful Attack dice by 1 for each 1 you rolled.

advances.name: Ooze Form
advances.description: Spend 1 Blood: squeeze through gaps, glop around, etc.
